text: Hey team, standup time! How's everyone doing?
Morning! The new dashboard components are deployed to staging.
Cool. The API is still returning 500s on the /analytics endpoint though.
That's been happening for two days now. What's the blocker?
The database migration script corrupted the indexes. I need DBA access to fix it.
Why wasn't this escalated earlier? The client is asking for a progress update TODAY.
I mentioned it in Monday's retro. Nobody followed up.
To be fair, the retro notes weren't shared. I didn't know about this either.
OK, my bad on the follow-up. Let me get you DBA access right now. @Backend Dev, can you fix it within 2 hours?
If I get access in the next 30 minutes, yes. Definitely.
Done. Check your email. And let's make sure retro action items go into Jira from now on.
Agreed. I'll set up a template for that. No more things falling through the cracks.
Got the access. Starting the fix now. Will update in the channel when it's done.
Perfect. Thanks team. Let's keep the momentum going!
